description: CityGML building attributes read with keepCodeSpace and written back: core properties land in schema order around the geometry; a round-tripped gen:stringAttribute and a computed gen:measureAttribute (from genericAttributes, with its uom) sit at the CityObject hook; bldg:class keeps its code and its codeSpace is rewritten to the codelist staged beside the output, whose copy is compared as text; and an xAL address is written with xmlns:xAL declared on its outermost xAL element, leaving the root's declarations unchanged.
